briefs.explicit:
MISSION BRIEF S-006
Units: metres, seconds, kilograms. Time starts at t = 0 when every robot leaves its start location.

Locations (x, y, zone):
- base: (0, 0), outdoor
- office roof: (-128, -137), roof
- pump house: (56, -106), indoor
- transformer pad: (74, 67), outdoor
- fuel depot: (-60, 117), outdoor

Robots:
- D1 (quadcopter): starts at base. Flies in straight lines at 8.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and roof locations, not indoor ones. Equipment: camera, cargo carrier (max 2 kg), thermal camera. Endurance: 900 s, including the return to its start.
- M1 (mobile_manipulator): starts at base. Drives on the road grid (travel distance = |dx| + |dy|) at 1.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and indoor locations, not roofs. Equipment: cargo carrier (max 8 kg), robotic arm, camera. Endurance: 2940 s, including the return to its start.
- D2 (quadcopter): starts at base. Flies in straight lines at 6.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and roof locations, not indoor ones. Equipment: camera, cargo carrier (max 2 kg), thermal camera. Endurance: 1320 s, including the return to its start.

Tasks:
- T1: Run a thermal scan of transformer pad. Location: transformer pad. Duration: 120 s. Needs: thermal camera. Deadline: finished by t = 300 s.
- T2: Run a thermal scan of transformer pad. Location: transformer pad. Duration: 180 s. Needs: thermal camera. Deadline: finished by t = 360 s.
- T3: Tighten the valve at fuel depot. Location: fuel depot. Duration: 270 s. Needs: robotic arm. Deadline: finished by t = 720 s. Can start only after T4 is finished.
- T4: Deliver the sensor box (8 kg) to fuel depot. Location: fuel depot. Duration: 60 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 8 kg). Deadline: finished by t = 360 s.
- T5: Inspect office roof with a camera. Location: office roof. Duration: 180 s. Needs: camera.

Rules:
1. Every task is done by exactly one robot. A robot does its tasks one at a time, in the order you list them, travelling between task locations.
2. A robot can only do a task if it has the needed equipment, enough payload capacity, and can reach the task location.
3. A task that must start after another task waits until that task is finished, even if a different robot does it.
4. Each robot must be back at its start location before its endurance runs out.
5. Every task must be finished by t = 900 s.

Objective: minimise the finish time of the last task (the makespan).
briefs.informal:
Morning! Plan for today's site work:

Positions are in metres from the base at (0, 0). Drones fly straight and can't go indoors; ground robots follow the road grid (so they travel |dx| + |dy|) and can't get onto roofs. Everyone leaves their start spot at time zero.

Places: office roof (-128, -137, a rooftop); pump house (56, -106, indoors); transformer pad (74, 67, outside); fuel depot (-60, 117, outside).

The fleet: D1 is a quadcopter at base with a camera and a thermal camera; it flies at 8.5 m/s, can lift 2 kg, and its battery lasts 15 minutes including the flight home. M1 is our mobile manipulator at base: gripper arm, camera, room for 8 kg, moves at 1.5 m/s and lasts 49 minutes including getting back. D2 is a quadcopter at base with a camera and a thermal camera; it flies at 6.5 m/s, can lift 2 kg, and its battery lasts 22 minutes including the flight home.

Jobs:
(T1) Check transformer pad for hot spots - that takes 2 minutes on site and it has to be finished within the first 5 minutes.
(T2) Check transformer pad for hot spots - that takes 3 minutes on site and it has to be finished within the first 6 minutes.
(T3) The valve at fuel depot needs tightening - that takes 4.5 minutes on site but only once the sensor box (T4) has arrived and it has to be finished within the first 12 minutes.
(T4) Fuel depot needs the sensor box, which weighs 8 kg - that takes 1 minute on site and it has to be finished within the first 6 minutes.
(T5) Get eyes on office roof and check the panels - that takes 3 minutes on site.

Everything has to be wrapped up within 15 minutes of the start, and the sooner the last job finishes, the better. Every robot has to make it back to where it started before its battery runs out.
